newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Roof collapse kills man in Ukraine coal mine.
newsitem.headline: Roof collapse kills man in Ukraine coal mine.

text.p: The deputy head of a Ukrainian coal pit was killed when the roof of his mine fell in on him, a spokesman said on Tuesday.

Boris Brusilovsky, an administration official in the eastern Ukrainian coal mining region, told Reuters the accident happened late on Monday at Chaykine mine in the town of Makeyevka, about 30 km (20 miles) east of Donetsk.
"The roof collapsed and killed the mine's deputy director, Mykola Zolotaryov. Rescue workers were unable to save him and so far have not even retrieved the body," Brusilovsky said.
In the first six months of the year, 97 miners were killed in the ageing pits of the Donbass coalfield.
